subject: MAXESS Master Engineering + Design North Star

naya.summary: MAXESS is being rebuilt as one unified, deterministic, extensible assessment-and-learning machine. E00/E00.01/E00.02/E00.03 and E01-E09 are source material and lessons, not sacred implementation boundaries. Preserve proven behavior, remove unnecessary complexity, and converge on one state machine, one assessment compiler, one scoring authority, one MAXESS_RESULT_V1 contract, and one release path. The flagship AI Score remains the golden reference. Dynamic topic assessment is compiled from structured knowledge and deterministic rules without a mandatory runtime LLM API.
principles: The human experience is a beautiful heart wrapped around an extraordinarily powerful machine.
Optimize every layer for correctness, speed, simplicity, beauty, tactile interaction, warmth, trust, accessibility, maintainability, and evidence.
Questions must test capability, not merely confidence, and each answer must represent a defensible 0-4 capability level.
MAXESS should honestly communicate coverage limits rather than fabricate authority.
Every meaningful mastermind/project session should capture durable decisions, discoveries, lessons, design principles, failures, safeguards, and next actions when they have future value.
Ask continuously: Can this be faster? Simpler? Clearer? More beautiful? More alive? More present? Warmer? More trustworthy? More accessible? More resilient? More effortless? What would make it a 10?

human.summary: Shawn set the new MAXESS standard: stop preserving separate E00 bridge pieces for their own sake. Learn from everything already built, unify what works, remove what causes problems, and build the flagship machine to an elite engineering and design standard. MAXESS must feel like a high-tech scoring machine created by someone with a beautiful heart: powerful, fast, simple, warm, alive, elegant, and deeply helpful. The system should eventually let people enter an AI/life-related topic and receive a fair, useful, learning-first assessment, while AI Score remains the lead example.
decisions: The physical boundaries of E00/E00.01/E00.02/E00.03 are not sacred; successful behavior is the authority.
The current architecture should be consolidated when one implementation is more reliable and simpler.
AI Score is the golden regression/reference assessment for the dynamic engine.
Runtime assessment generation should not require a paid LLM API; use structured knowledge and deterministic compilation as the primary model.
Dynamic assessments may cover advanced topics such as quantum computing when supported by the knowledge bank; unsupported depth must be handled honestly.
MAXESS visual and interaction quality is a first-class engineering requirement, not post-production decoration.
